Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_0_Legend: Alive Time = The time before the Raid Boss disappears from the map.
Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_1_Legend: Spawn Chance = Base value as a percentage + daily increase by which the Raid Boss appears on the adventure map.
Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_2_Legend: The tiles in X and Y coordinates around a town.
Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_3_Legend: The number in days before a new Raid Boss can appear on the adventure map.
Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_4_Legend: Start Delay in days counting from day 1.
Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_5_Info:
{Special Chance}

The likelihood of a random ability event occurring during a raid boss encounter is expressed as a percentage. It is recommended to set this to 1%, or to 0% if you want to make fights more difficult and unpredictable by removing any randomness.
Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_6_Info:
{ACM Rewards}

Adds special rewards to the pool, that can only be used when combined with the Advanced Classes mod.
Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_7_Info:
{No Town Plunder}

When this option is enabled, a Raid Boss that reaches your town will not steal gold or resources.
Raid_Config.RaidBoss_Option_8_Info:
{More Rewards}

When this option is enabled, defeating a Raid Boss grants an additional gold reward.
